description: This file manages tool policy logic, including importing shared functions, defining owner-only tool policies, filtering tools based on ownership, and handling plugin tool groups and allowlists.

methods.name: wrapOwnerOnlyToolExecution
methods.description: Wraps a tool's execute method to restrict execution to owner-only tools, throwing an error if sender is not owner.

methods.name: resolveOwnerOnlyToolApprovalClass
methods.description: Resolves the approval class for a given tool name based on fallback mappings.

methods.name: isOwnerOnlyToolName
methods.description: Checks if a tool name corresponds to an owner-only tool.

methods.name: isOwnerOnlyTool
methods.description: Determines if a tool is owner-only based on its properties or name.

methods.name: applyOwnerOnlyToolPolicy
methods.description: Filters and wraps tools based on owner-only policy, considering sender's ownership status.

methods.name: collectExplicitAllowlist
methods.description: Collects and trims allowed tool entries from a list of policies.

methods.name: buildPluginToolGroups
methods.description: Builds a structure grouping tools by plugin ID and listing all tools.

methods.name: expandPluginGroups
methods.description: Expands plugin group references into actual tool names based on plugin groups.

methods.name: expandPolicyWithPluginGroups
methods.description: Expands allow and deny lists in a policy with plugin group references.

methods.name: analyzeAllowlistByToolType
methods.description: Analyzes a policy's allowlist to determine if it contains only plugin tools and identifies unknown entries.

methods.name: mergeAlsoAllowPolicy
methods.description: Merges additional allowed tool entries into an existing policy's allow list.
